provider.name: ZooBank
provider.organization_type: official zoological nomenclatural registry for acts, publications, authors, LSIDs, electronic-publication compliance, typification, API, and data-export infrastructure
provider.description: ZooBank is the official registry of zoological nomenclature associated with the International Commission on Zoological Nomenclature. It records nomenclatural acts, works, authors, registration timestamps, Life Science Identifiers, type information, publication metadata, and relationships required to document and verify zoological names and electronic-publication compliance.
institutional_context: Zoological taxonomists, journals, publishers, museums, collections, and nomenclatural registrars
Crossref, ORCID, Biodiversity Heritage Library, GBIF, Catalogue of Life, and linked taxonomic infrastructures

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting ZooBank documentation, organization, governance, accounts, registration, nomenclatural acts, publications, authors, LSIDs, typification, electronic-publication requirements, APIs, downloads, schemas, identifiers, corrections, editorial workflows, data quality, licenses, citations, software, standards, the ICZN Code, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: ZooBank, the International Commission on Zoological Nomenclature, the current International Code of Zoological Nomenclature, official Opinions and Declarations, original publications, type repositories, registry records, and cited authorities remain authoritative for nomenclatural acts, publication requirements, types, identifiers, dates, versions, rights, and contacts.
